fichas.title: Types of Road
fichas.summary: Road classification depends on location inside or outside a built-up area, the road’s network function, and whether adjacent buildings and properties are served. Roads without adjacent buildings are designed primarily for vehicle traffic; roads with adjacent buildings also serve public-space, social, commercial, recreational, and environmental functions. Road cross-section design considers traffic and pedestrian uses, safety clearances, zones, road type, parking and green areas, public transport, and pedestrian-area uses.
